*** Begin Patch

+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+data = duckdb.connect().execute(
+    """
+    SELECT
+        year(crash_date)::INTEGER AS year,
+        sum(coalesce(number_of_pedestrians_injured, 0))::INTEGER AS pedestrian_injuries,
+        sum(coalesce(number_of_pedestrians_killed, 0))::INTEGER AS pedestrian_fatalities
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE upper(borough) = 'BROOKLYN'
+      AND crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY 1
+    ORDER BY 1
+    """
+).df()
+data["pedestrian_casualties"] = data["pedestrian_injuries"] + data["pedestrian_fatalities"]
+
+options = [
+    (1, "pedestrian_casualties", "Pedestrians injured or killed", "#176B87", "people"),
+    (2, "pedestrian_fatalities", "Pedestrians killed", "#B43C45", "people killed"),
+    (3, "pedestrian_injuries", "Pedestrians injured (nonfatal)", "#D07B25", "people injured"),
+]
+
+plt.rcParams.update({
+    "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
+    "font.size": 10,
+    "axes.titleweight": "bold",
+    "axes.spines.top": False,
+    "axes.spines.right": False,
+})
+
+for option_id, metric, title, color, unit in options:
+    values = data[["year", metric]].copy()
+    values.to_csv(OUT / f"values_{option_id}.csv", index=False)
+
+    first = int(values.loc[values.year == 2013, metric].iloc[0])
+    last = int(values.loc[values.year == 2025, metric].iloc[0])
+    change_pct = (last / first - 1) * 100
+    change_text = f"2013–2025: {change_pct:+.0f}% ({first:,} → {last:,})"
+
+    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+    ax.plot(values.year, values[metric], color=color, linewidth=2.8, marker="o", markersize=5.5)
+    ax.fill_between(values.year, values[metric], color=color, alpha=0.09)
+    ax.set_title(f"Brooklyn: {title}, by year", fontsize=17, loc="left", pad=15)
+    ax.text(0, 1.02, change_text, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=11, color=color, weight="bold")
+    ax.set_ylabel(unit)
+    ax.set_xlabel("")
+    ax.set_xticks(values.year)
+    ax.set_xticklabels(values.year, rotation=45, ha="right")
+    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#D9DEE3", linewidth=0.8)
+    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+    ax.margins(x=0.025, y=0.2)
+    ax.annotate(f"{first:,}", (2013, first), xytext=(0, 10), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", color=color, weight="bold")
+    ax.annotate(f"{last:,}", (2025, last), xytext=(-2, 10), textcoords="offset points", ha="right", color=color, weight="bold")
+    fig.text(0.01, 0.015, "Source: police-reported crash data provided; Brooklyn; complete calendar years only (2013–2025).", fontsize=8, color="#50565C")
+    fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.045, 1, 1))
+    fig.savefig(OUT / f"option_{option_id}.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+    plt.close(fig)
+
+print(data.to_string(index=False))
*** End Patch
